recommended_change: Maintain an evidence-backed ledger of required APIs, types, resources, environment assumptions, and unresolved dependencies before implementation
Use focused differential probes, counterexamples, and failing-behavior repair instead of broad repeated testing
Allocate phase budgets, score information gain, suppress unchanged reads, and enforce stop-or-switch checkpoints
Trigger state/import/environment/resource probes only from concrete dynamic-risk cues and preserve the resulting state model
Optimize the minimal semantic slice and continuously check forbidden imports, extraction ratio, and packaged resources
Invalidate stale test conclusions after every edit and require targeted probes, public tests, isolation, and clean-install gates
Keep a pinned structured evidence store separate from rolling dialogue summaries and deduplicate file snapshots
Use symbol/file retrieval improvements only after higher-value post-localization bottlenecks are addressed
